execution_status_note: This bundle is a constructive theorem (THEORETICAL-DERIVATION) with proof sketches, verified by exhaustive exact computation on small finite state spaces (up to a few thousand systems per check). It has not been applied to a trained neural network or any other real, high-dimensional system. Continuous/approximate realization and the full stochastic path-law extension are both explicitly OPEN, not attempted here.

claims: exact predictive realization: c_d A_pred^k eta(z) = d(F^k(E(z))) for every source, readout, delay
Q_{E,D} is the coarsest deterministic state quotient preserving all future declared readouts
V_{E,D} is minimal among reachable exact linear realizations; minimal realizations are isomorphic
generalized future-readout Hankel rank equals dim(V_{E,D}) in finite-dimensional cases
Q_{E,D} and V_{E,D} are genuinely different minimality notions, not to be conflated

open_extensions.note: Not established in this bundle; see docs/stochastic-extension-and-open-questions.md. The continuous side is developed separately, and likewise left open, in campaign 10-continuous-predictive-geometry/.

claim_boundary: This is an exact algebraic theorem plus exhaustive small-finite-universe verification. It characterizes predictive capacity under a declared readout class, not realized causal use, and is not evidence for or against phenomenal consciousness on its own.
